function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Book an arrival window. ONLY call after reading back the window, address and problem and hearing the caller say yes; then set caller_confirmed to true. For a verified caller pass customer_id and address_id from lookup_customer and leave out name, phone and address (they come from the account). Otherwise pass first_name, last_name and address. Returns booked:true, or ok:false with reason slot_taken and alternatives. One appointment per call: calling it again for the same window adds the new details to that appointment's notes, and a different window moves the call's booking (the old window is released). Call it once; only again if the caller changes the window or a detail.

slot_id.description: slot_id of the window the caller chose.

caller_confirmed.description: Always include it: true once the caller said yes to your read-back. Never ask for the yes twice.

customer_id.description: From lookup_customer, if found and confirmed.

first_name.description: Caller's first name. Omit when customer_id is given (it comes from the account).

last_name.description: Caller's last name. Omit when customer_id is given (it comes from the account).

phone.description: Best callback number if different from caller ID, read back in groups and confirmed. Omit when customer_id is given unless they gave a new number.

address_id.description: address_id from lookup_customer when using an address on file.

line1.description: House number and street, e.g. 37-12 82nd St.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code of the service address, e.g. 11372.

service_type.description: maintenance = tune-up; repair = known problem; diagnostic = unknown cause.

urgency.description: From triage: book_earliest = urgent, book_standard = routine.

issue_summary.description: One-sentence description of the problem in the caller's words.

symptoms.description: Specific symptoms, e.g. 'blowing cold air', 'clicking noise'.

onset.description: When the problem started, in the caller's words, e.g. 'since last night'.

equipment.description: Equipment involved, if known: type, brand, age.

tried_steps.description: What the caller already tried, e.g. 'thermostat set to heat at 72', 'reset the breaker'. Empty array if nothing.

error_code.description: Error code, blinking light pattern or display message, if any.

pets.description: Pets at the home, e.g. 'one dog, will be crated'.

on_site_contact.description: Only when the caller is calling for someone else (e.g. a parent): the person who will be at the home.

phone.description: On-site contact's phone, if different from the caller's.

relationship.description: Relationship to the caller, e.g. 'caller's mother'.

vulnerable_occupants.description: Vulnerable people in the home. Empty array if none.

arrival_preference.description: Only if the caller asked for an exact time inside the window, e.g. 'around 8:30 AM'. Noted for the technician, never promised. To add it (or any detail) after booking, call book_appointment again with the same slot_id: it updates the same appointment.
